name: Ticket Enrichment + Remediation — AI-Driven Incident Response
description: Extends the enrichment workflow with automated remediation. Gathers diagnostics, performs AI root cause analysis, then an AI agent discovers the appropriate AAP job template name. A separate AAP node runs that template. If no suitable fix is found, the incident is updated with the analysis only.

incident_description.description: Combined short_description + description from the incident

extra_vars.work_notes: [AUTOMATED — Remediation Complete] Fix applied using job template: ${select_fix_agent.result.content.fix_template_name}

[AUTOMATED — No Automated Fix Available] The AI agent could not find a suitable job template to remediate this issue. Manual intervention is required. Please review the root cause analysis above for remediation guidance.
